title.rurdu: Masjid mein daakhil hone ke baad
title.urdu: مسجد میں تشریف لاتے تو نماز سے پہلے

desc.en: The reciter asks for everything he needs in this world, and will be in need of on the day of judgment. All pious religious scholars recite this dua at the time of tawaf of Ka-bah. The power of this dua is that you can have your complete needs in one dua…
desc.rurdu: Is dua ko padhne waala har woh haajaat ko talab karta hai jo uski duniya aur aakherat ke liye zaroori hai. Muqaddas Ulma is dua ko Kaabe ka tawaaf karte waqt padhte hai. Is dua ki taaqat yeh hai keh is dua mein har woh haajat shaamil hai jo padhne waale ki zaroorat hai…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اِلٰهِیْ بِاَخَصِّ صِفَاتِكَ وَبِعَزِّ جَلَالِكَ وَاَعْظَمِ اَسْمَائِكَ وَبِعِصْمَۃِ اَنْۢبَیَائِكَ وَبِنُوْرِ اَوْلِیَائِكَ وَبِدَمِ شُهَدَائِكَ وَبِمِدَادِ عُلَمَائِكَ وَبِدُعَائِ صُلَحَائِكَ وَبِمُنَاجَاۃِ فُقَرَائِكَ نَسْاَلُكَ زِیَادَۃً فِی الْعِلْمِ وَصِحَۃً فِیْ الْجِسْمِ وَطُوْلًا فِی الْعُمْرِ فِیْ طَاعَتِكْ وَسِعَۃً فِیْ الرِّزْقِ وَتَوْبَۃً قَبْلَ الْمَوْتَ وَرَاحَۃً عِنْدَ الْمَوْتَ وَمَغْفِرَۃً بَعْدَ الْمَوْتَ وَنُوْرًا فِی الْقَبْرِ وَنَجَاۃٍ مِنَ النَّارِ وَدُخُوْلًا فِی الْجَنَّۃِ وَعَافِیَۃٍ مِّنْ كُلِّ بَلَائِ الدُّنْیَا وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَۃْ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَهْلِ بَیْتِهِ الطَّیِّبِیْنَ الطَّاهِرِیْنَ الْمَعْصُوْمِیْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: ILAA-HEE BE-AKHAS-SE SEFAATE-KA WA BE I’ZZE JALAALE-KA WA A’ZAME ASMAA-E-KA WA BE-I’SMATE AMBIYAA-E-KA WA BE-NOORE AWLEYAA-E-KA WA BE-DAME SHOHADAA-E-KA WA BE-MEDAADE O’LAMAA-E-KA WA BE-DOAA’-E SOLAHAA-E-KA WA BE-MONAA-JAATE FOQRAA-E-KA NAS-ALOKA ZEYAA-DATAN FIL I’LME WA SEHA-TAN FIL JISME WA TOOLAN FIL U’MRE FEE TAA-A’TEK WA SE-A’TAN FIR RIZQE WA TAW-BATAN QABLAL MAWTA WA RAA-HATAN I’NDAL MAWTA WA MAGH-FERA-TAN BA’DAL MAWTA WA NOORAN FIL QABRE WA NAJAA-TAN MENAN NAARE WA DOKHOO-LAN FIL JANNATE WA AA’FE-YATIM MIN KULLE BALAA-ID DUNYAA WA A’ZAA-BIL AA-KHE-RAT BE-HAQQE MOHAMMADIN WA AHLE BAIYTE-HIT TAYYE-BEE-NAT TAAHE-REE-NAL MA’SOO-MEENA.

trans.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, Allah, in the name of your most special, in the name of the dignity of your exalted majesty, in the name of the greatness of your names, in the name of the purity of your prophets, in the name of the light of your chosen representatives, in the name of the blood shed by the martyrs in your cause, in the name of the ink used by the scholars of your purpose and plan, in the name of the prayers of the righteous and in the name of the invocations made by your servants leaving in resignation and asceticism,We beseech you for continuous addition in knowledge, freedom from sickness in the body, long duration of life spent in your obedience abundance in the means of livelihood, divine guidance to turn repentant unto you, before death, freedom from pain at the time of death, protection after death, light in the grave, escape from the hell, entry into the paradise and safety from all the evils of the world and from the chastisement in the hereafter, in the name and for the sake of Muhammad and his pure, purified and infallible progeny.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
